content: Now, former Savannah police officer Amber Harpe was fired in August following a department investigation that found she had shared her Flock login information with her husband, Tyler Harpe, an ICE agent. SPD does not share its Flock data with ICE and said sharing access to the system violated the department’s security protocols. While he had unauthorized access to the system, Tyler Harpe conducted 983 searches related to 97 license plates, which were overwhelmingly registered to Hispanic drivers, according to Savannah’s local ABC affiliate, WJCL. The Harpes defended their actions, saying they didn’t use access for personal reasons and that the searches were strictly for “law-enforcement purposes.” Interim Major Max Nowinsky originally recommended a light eight-hour suspension for Harpe. However, Major Michelle Halford and Assistant Police Chief Robert Gavin disagreed, and they removed her from the force. Harpe was fired, along with five other SPD employees, after an internal investigation uncovered Flock misuse. Four of them were later arrested; however, Harpe was not one of them.

chineseContent: 现在，前萨凡纳警官安布尔·哈普 (Amber Harpe) 于 8 月被解雇，此前部门调查发现她与她的丈夫、ICE 特工泰勒·哈普 (Tyler Harpe) 分享了 Flock 登录信息。 SPD 不与 ICE 共享其 Flock 数据，并表示共享系统访问权限违反了该部门的安全协议。据萨凡纳当地 ABC 附属机构 WJCL 称，虽然泰勒·哈普未经授权访问了该系统，但他进行了 983 次搜索，涉及 97 个车牌，其中绝大多数是西班牙裔司机。竖琴乐队为自己的行为进行了辩护，称他们并非出于个人原因使用访问权限，而且搜查完全是为了“执法目的”。临时少校马克斯·诺温斯基最初建议对哈普进行八小时的轻微停赛。然而，米歇尔·哈尔福德少校和助理警察局长罗伯特·加文不同意，他们将她从警队中除名。在内部调查发现 Flock 滥用之后，哈普和其他五名 SPD 员工被解雇。其中四人后来被捕；然而，哈普并不是其中之一。
